inputs.required_evidence: This complete value is a stipulated model hypothesis, including strings and nested numeric fields. Supply an actual registered center and tangent basis on the specified land, frame transform, fiducials, uncertainty and component placement. The nominal land datum is not a selected port center.

Supply prep/primer/mix/open-time/cure history, cure/backing fixtures, accessible inspection method and damage/debond/barrier-restoration route. Removal is not automatically safe reversal.
